classification.difficultyReason: Construct a cosine value table and extend the plotted first-quadrant values using symmetry.

content.prompt: Draw up a table of values of $y=\cos\theta$ for $0^\circ\leq\theta\leq90^\circ$, correct to two decimal places, using increments of $10^\circ$. Using your table of values, plus symmetry, plot the graph of $y=\cos\theta$ for $0^\circ\leq\theta\leq360^\circ$.

spec.description: Complete cosine curve on 0 to 360 degrees, with plotted points at ten-degree intervals and labelled quarter-turn ticks. No grid is supplied in the source answer.
spec.mathematics: y=cos(theta), degrees; maxima (0,1) and (360,1), minimum (180,-1), zeros 90 and 270; reflection symmetry about theta=180 degrees.
